master.definition_en: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from paraganglia located along the sympathetic or parasympathetic nerves. Infrequently, it may arise outside the usual distribution of the sympathetic and parasympathetic paraganglia. Tumors arising from the adrenal gland medulla are called pheochromocytomas. Morphologically, paragangliomas usually display a nesting (Zellballen) growth pattern. There are no reliable morphologic criteria to distinguish between benign and malignant paragangliomas. The only definitive indicator of malignancy is the presence of regional or distant metastases.

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 胸部与浆膜腔极高凶险实体瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 与石棉职业/环境暴露高度相关（潜伏期长达20–40年），肿瘤沿胸膜呈“盔甲样”弥漫包裹肺脏并产生大量血性胸水，患者常因顽固性胸痛、进行性呼吸困难及肺不张在1年内衰竭死亡；并发张力性大量恶性胸腔积液或恶性心包填塞时可在数小时至数日内窒息/循环衰竭猝死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 高度难治的恶性肿瘤之一，极少能在早期实现彻底根治，整体5年生存率仅约10%–12%；但CheckMate 743等研究确立的纳武利尤单抗+伊匹木单抗双免疫方案及化疗+帕博利珠单抗(KEYNOTE-483)已将晚期中位总生存从约12个月延长至18个月以上（肉瘤样亚型获益尤为显著）。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 2022年全球约2.27万例死亡，死亡发病比高达0.83，绝大多数源于既往石棉工业暴露

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 2022年中国约1,681例死亡，但因既往石棉建材及造船业暴露存在20–40年滞后效应及基层病理漏诊，实际疾病负担可能被低估

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 2022年全球新发约27,350例，胸膜间皮瘤占80%–85%，腹膜间皮瘤约占10%–15%（GLOBOCAN 2022）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 2022年中国新发约2,381例，浙江大窑、云南大姚等既往青石棉环境暴露区及重工业区为高发监测点

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 恶性大量胸腔积液致急性呼吸窘迫、端坐呼吸及低氧血症：立即吸氧并行床旁超声引导下胸腔穿刺置管引流（首次放液不超过800–1000ml，防复张性肺水肿）; 2) 肿瘤侵犯心包致急性心包填塞（低血压、颈静脉怒张、心音遥远）：立即床旁超声引导下心包穿刺引流减压。

极早期上皮样患者可谨慎评估胸膜剥脱/去皮质术(P/D)，近年来MARS 2研究提示扩大手术获益有限，切忌盲目行胸膜外全肺切除
年轻、无石棉暴露史或家族多发肿瘤患者排查BAP1肿瘤易感综合征胚系突变（关联葡萄膜黑色素瘤、肾癌）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 2024年9月FDA批准帕博利珠单抗联合培美曲塞+铂类一线治疗晚期恶性胸膜间皮瘤(KEYNOTE-483); 2) 精氨酸剥夺疗法ADI-PEG20联合化疗在ASS1缺失的非上皮样间皮瘤3期ATOMIC-Meso试验中取得总生存阳性突破; 3) 靶向间皮素(Mesothelin)的CAR-T细胞疗法与ADC药物，以及针对BAP1/CDKN2A/MTAP合成致死通路的PRMT5/MAT2A抑制剂正处于1/2期临床前沿。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 缺乏针对间皮瘤高频抑癌基因缺失（BAP1、NF2、CDKN2A）的已上市精准靶向药; 2) 上皮样以外的肉瘤样/双相型间皮瘤对化疗极度耐药，整体中位生存仍不足1.5年; 3) 胸腔镜活检前常被误诊为‘结核性胸膜炎’导致长期误治。

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: Segmental outgrowth-lipomatosis-arteriovenous malformation-epidermal nevus syndrome is a rare, genetic, polymalformative syndrome characterized by progressive, proportionate, asymmetric segmental overgrowth (with soft tissue hypertrophy and ballooning effect) that develops and progresses rapidly in early childhood, arteriovenous and lymphatic vascular malformations, lipomatosis and linear epidermal nevus (arranged in whorls along the lines of Blaschko). Patients present an increased risk of developing cancer.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A hepatic porphyria caused by monoallelic and biallelic variants in HMBS and presenting as a spectrum of disease (a semidominant inheritance pattern). Monoallelic variants predispose to acute/episodic attacks in adulthood with abdominal pain, neuropathy, and neuropsychiatric symptoms (women are more often affected) without cutaneous manifestations. Triggers precipitating acute attacks include estrogen/progesterone, oral contraceptives, alcohol, drugs, stress, or infections. Biallelic variants cause severe disease in childhood presenting with neurological issues including developmental abnormalities, ataxia, dysarthria, leukoencephalopathy, cataracts and optic nerve hypoplasia.

master.definition_en: A rare otorhinolaryngologic disease characterized by recurrent and severe obstruction of the central airway in the region bounded superiorly by a plane below the glottis and inferiorly by the first two tracheal rings. Symptoms may involve respiratory distress, dysphonia, exertional dyspnea, stridor, chronic cough and wheezing. Diagnosis is challenging due to the lack of apparent etiology and nonspecific respiratory symptoms that can be confounded with other common respiratory diseases and may also occur in late course of the disease. Thorough clinical and laboratory evaluation aims to exclude other causes of subglottic stenosis is therefore essential. Affected patients are almost exclusively Caucasian women between 30-60 years old.

master.definition_en: A rare dysraphic abnormality characterized by a persistent connection between the neural tissue and overlying skin. The stalk-like connection consists of a fibroneural tract (mainly composed of fibrous attenuated mesenchymal tissue and neural elements without an epithelial lining) connecting the skin lesion to the underlying dorsal surface of the spinal cord. Fibroneural stalk varies in thickness and complexity and they pass through the deep fascia, a bifid lamina/ the interspinous ligament, and the dura. It can be associated with filum anomaly. Chiari II malformation is not present.

master.definition_en: Any tubulinopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the TUBB gene. Heterozygous TUBB variants cause two overlapping developmental disorders, complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations (CDCBM) and congenital symmetric circumferential skin creases (CSCSC), also known as circumferential skin creases Kunze type. The clinical findings are diverse and include abnormalities of the cortex, basal ganglia, corpus callosum, brain stem and cerebellum, microcephaly, intellectual disability, facial dysmorphism, excess skin folding and growth retardation.

master.name_en: Scarring in glaucoma filtration surgical procedures
master.definition_en: A rare ophthalmic condition characterized by formation of excessive scar tissue between the conjunctiva/Tenon capsule and the sclera at the surgical site following glaucoma filtration surgery. Scarring can occur months or years after surgery, resulting in treatment failure with poor postoperative control of intraocular pressure and, potentially, loss of vision.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: A heterogenous group of rare endocrine diseases characterized by a generalized or localized loss of adipose tissue (lipoatropy) associated with dysmetabolic alterations with insulin resistance, altered glucose tolerance or diabetes, and hypertriglyceridemia leading to a risk of acute pancreatitis. The diabetes leads to chronic complications involving the retina, kidney, nerves and cardiovascular system, and to liver steatosis that could result in cirrhosis. In some forms, lipoatrophy is associated with selective hypertrophy of other fat deposits. Clinical signs of insulin resistance (acanthosis nigricans and signs of hyperandrogenism) are often present. It has both genetic and acquired forms.

master.name_en: Off-periods in Parkinson disease not responding to oral treatment
master.definition_en: A rare clinical situation occurring in the context of Parkinson disease characterized by return or worsening of symptoms (including motor and/or non-motor symptoms) under antiparkinsonian therapy. Types of off-periods are Morning Off (experienced before the first dose of the day), Delayed On (occurring more frequently after the first dose of the day or after meals), Wearing Off (end-of-dose deterioration), Sudden Off (sudden transition from on to off), and Dose Failure.
